polishes.description: Come to room 1410 for a night you'll never forget. This polish has a darkened brown base strewn with golden specks and a light pink/gold magnetic pull. Will you be knocking?

polishes.name: 97 Margaritas
polishes.description: Grandma loved a good margarita! Refresh your look with 97 Margaritas, a glowy green shimmer with holo flakes, and lime/copper/blue shifting flakes. Wear alone for an ethereal shimmer or mix up something new by layering over your favorite shades.

polishes.name: Arcane Glass
polishes.description: Arcane Glass glitters in the gloom, bringing light and wonder where it is needed most. This light purple based polish is packed with green shimmer, purple and green micro glitters, and reflective glitter. Super smooth and buildable, layer to create extra depth to fit your desired mood.

polishes.name: At Dusk
polishes.description: At Dusk resonates as a rich purple creme with soft shimmer. Everything slows as the quiet of night approaches and the promise of tomorrow settles in.

polishes.name: Beautiful Breakdown Le
polishes.description: Beautiful Breakdown has a deep violet base with purple-blue iridescent glitters and holo flakes. This sparkling purple delight is both bold and playful, having a moody depth that truly illuminates in the light. *this was formerly a freebie polish released with the store launch* this polish is archived. it is not available for purchase and is only a reference for a previously released polish.

polishes.name: Berry the Hatchet
polishes.description: Berry the Hatchet is a luscious magenta berry creme. It's peaceful and satisfying, like feeling rewarded after harvesting a homegrown bounty.

polishes.name: Burst of Embers
polishes.description: Burst of Embers is a raspberry/cranberry jelly based polish with an intense gold-to-orange shimmer and scattered red sparkle. This precious garnet shade, created for the Red Polish Society group on Facebook, catches the eye like a glistening gem.

polishes.name: Canceled Plans
polishes.description: Canceled Plans has a grape base with silver and magenta shimmer, a teal magnetic pull, and violet light reflective glitter. This polish shines like an introvert who's just read a text saying, "sorry, I have to cancel!"

polishes.name: Capy Hour
polishes.description: Every hour is Capy Hour with this glistening group custom polish created for the Pawsitively Polished & Friends Facebook group. Capy Hour is a rich, metallic copper with gold flecks and bronze holo. Team Capybara vs Team Quokka.The winning team will receive all of the donations from both polishes for its chosen charity! $5 from each bottle will be donated to https://rousfoundation.com to help improve the quality and duration of life of captive capybaras.

polishes.name: Champagne on Ice
polishes.description: Champagne on Ice is a transformative shade that truly shines in the light! With a copper-gold base, rainbow holo and gold light reflective glitter, this polish will have you rejoicing as you sparkle and shine! Perfect for uplifting spirits year round. Shown in 2 coats with a top coat on a clear swatch wheel

polishes.name: Changing Light
polishes.description: Changing Light is a deep teal polish with a touch of shimmer. Perfect for between seasons, this polish feels refreshing in the heat, yet earthy and grounded as summer wanes.

polishes.name: Chapter 42
polishes.description: Turn the page and discover Chapter 42, a rich sparkling purple polish brimming with fine silver metallic shimmers. It's mysterious and moody, leaving you on the edge of your seat.

polishes.name: Chocolate Driftwood
polishes.description: Chocolate Driftwood is a delectable chocolate brown polish with green shimmer and holo. The rich, earthy brown and soft suggestions of seaweed will take you away to a day at the beach.

polishes.name: Cocoa Sands
polishes.description: Dip your fingers and toes into the soft Cocoa Sands and indulge in this rich caramel brown polish, lightly dusted with green shimmer and holo. This polish is beautiful and unique, much like the Sirens who choose to adorn it.

polishes.name: Crimson Stardust
polishes.description: Crimson Stardust has a deep red base with red shimmer and holo flakes. It's tantalizing and positively alluring, like that little red dress you save for special occasions.

polishes.name: Cupid’s Favorite
polishes.description: Cupid's Favorite polish is sweet and alluring, creating a delicate and sparkling look. This flattering pink based polish has pink shimmer and silver, gold, and violet reflective glitter. You'll be smitten with this one.

polishes.name: Daydreamer
polishes.description: Get ready to be whisked away by Daydreamer, a delicate lavender polish illuminated with blue and silver shimmer. Perfect for wearing everyday as you stare longingly beyond reality.

polishes.name: Do as I Say
polishes.description: Do As I Say is a rich berry magenta based polish with orange/red shimmer, micro glitters and gold light reflecting glitter. This impressionable shade feels powerful yet sweet, like mom's soothing embrace.

polishes.name: Do as I Say / Not as I Do Duo
polishes.description: Do As I Say is a rich berry magenta based polish with orange/red shimmer, micro glitters and gold light reflecting glitter. This impressionable shade feels powerful yet sweet, like mom's soothing embrace. Not As I Do is a deep purple based polish packed with holo and fine micro glitters that flash red, blue and pink. Take a stand and let this sparkly beauty do the talking. Impulsive but strong, this polish captures the essence of good intentions.

polishes.name: Don’t Be Weevil Sou
polishes.description: This shade is Limited Edition and can only be purchased from https://www.smidgenofus.com Don't Be Weevil is a shifty blackened blue with green shimmer, flakes, and black & blue micro glitters. Inspired by the Blue Weevil Beetle from Animal Crossing, this sparkling gem is sure to catch your eye! Please note this shade is pre-order from 2/23/26-2/28/26. This shade can only be purchased on the Smidgen of Us Website.

polishes.name: Eggplant Whisperer
polishes.description: Eggplant Whisperer may not guarantee a green thumb, but it's sure to please those with a passion for purple. An eggplant creme polish, it captures the essence of this purple culinary delight.

polishes.name: End of the Rainbow
polishes.description: Look no further, you've finally found the End of the Rainbow; a golden yellow jelly polish packed with gold holo, red/orange shimmer, and holographic bar glitters. It's every Leprechaun's coveted treasure!

polishes.name: Evening Tide
polishes.description: Evening Tide is a light steel blue base with a green shimmer and holo glitters. Like the moon glistening upon shallow tide pools, this polish feels soft and serene.

polishes.name: Forbidden Cherries
polishes.description: Forbidden Cherries is a decadent sparkling chocolate cherry polish packed with tantalizing flakes. You'll be craving this rich, juicy polish over and over again. Forbidden Cherries is a Small Batch polish. There is a limited number available and the recipe was not written down. Once sold out this polish will not be returning.

polishes.name: Forbidden Shift
polishes.description: Forbidden Shift captures the feel of the seductive glow within a bustling club. This holo packed cranberry jelly based polish has a strong orange/red shimmer and a violet magnetic pull. Energetic and impulsive, like a night out chasing euphoria.

polishes.name: Frankenlacquer
polishes.description: **this polish will come in round bottles until further notice** This is a mystery polish made from more than two polishes (and up to 6). They may contain holo, shimmer, glitters, reflectives, and any other concoction that I’ve mixed together!

polishes.name: Gilded Embers
polishes.description: Burst of Embers Sibling! Gilded Embers is a stately golden-green jelly based polish illuminated by a gold to orange shimmer and scattered red sparkle. Like ripening pear skin, this polish shifts in color and feeds the senses.

polishes.name: Gimme Kiss
polishes.description: Swim on over and Gimme Kiss. This light grey-lavender based polish shimmers with holo and has a silver/slight pink magnetic pull. You'll want to dive right in.

polishes.name: Golden Hour
polishes.description: Golden Hour boasts a brilliant orange hue with subtle shimmer. As seasons change, this polish clings to warm summer nights, yet embraces the bite of a crisp autumn breeze.

polishes.name: Hailosaurus: Not Extinct Yet
polishes.description: Inspired by @haileemknails, Hailosaurus: Not Extinct Yet is a birthday polish with a fierce dino twist—a vibrant green packed with holographic sparkle, black flakes, and silver light reflecting glitter.

polishes.name: Happy-go-quokka
polishes.description: Created for the Pawsitively Polished & Friends Facebook group, Happy-Go-Quokka is a charming chameleon brown and gold metallic polish with yellow/ orange/ green flakes. Like the adorable quokka, this polish is sure to be an instant mood booster. Team Capybara vs Team Quokka.The winning team will receive all of the donations from both polishes for its chosen charity! $5 from each bottle will be donated to http://www.rottnestfoundation.org.au to support ongoing research into the health and habitat of the vulnerable quokka.

polishes.name: Heart-shaped Pizza
polishes.description: Nothing says love like a Heart-Shaped Pizza. This saucy red jelly based polish glistens with rose and red holo shimmer. It'll be sure to satisfy your cravings.

polishes.name: Hidden Embers
polishes.description: Burst of Embers Sibling! Hidden Embers glistens like sunshine filtered through a lush forest canopy. This rich green jelly based polish shimmers gold to orange and has scattered red sparks.

polishes.name: Honeyfire
polishes.collection: Honeyfire makes a unique statement that every polish
polishes.description: Honeyfire makes a unique statement that every polish collection needs. With a rose gold base, bronze holo glitters, holo flakes, and purple/ orange/yellow flakes, it brings warmth and whimsy to your day.

polishes.name: Hyperboost
polishes.description: Hyperboost is a seductive neon pink with gold shimmer. Be the life of the party with this shocking pink polish.

polishes.name: Insomnia Shift
polishes.description: Insomnia Shift is like twilight's gentle kiss goodnight to the earth as the stars come out to shine. This vibrant blue based polish has purple shimmer, holo and a blue magnetic effect. It's equally lovely unmagnetized.

polishes.name: Into the Void
polishes.description: Into the Void you'll find yourself enrobed in a navy blue based polish with red to orange shimmer and holo flakes. This grungy shade embraces a deep desire to flourish and persevere despite our challenges.

polishes.name: Love Shack
polishes.finish: Reflective, Iridescent, Holographic, Glitter, Flakes, Shimmer, Jelly
polishes.description: Love Shack is a sassy hot pink polish with dazzling flakes. Flirty and vivacious, this one's sure to turn heads! Love Shack is a Small Batch polish. There is a limited number available and the recipe was not written down. Once sold out this polish will not be returning.#5 shown in 2 coats with a top coat on a swatch stick.

polishes.name: Lucky Charm
polishes.description: Need a little luck? Lucky Charm is a green jelly polish with iridescent flakes and gold shimmer, packed with gold holo and light reflective glitter. Wearing this polish is a sure way to prevent any pesky pinching on St. Patrick's Day!

polishes.name: Mystery
polishes.description: Mystery Polish! If you’re hoping for something in particular, put it in the comments with your order and I’ll see what I have in stock!

polishes.name: Natalie’s Neat Birthday
polishes.description: Inspired by @nataliesneatnails, Natalie's Neat Birthday Polish celebrates the joys of all things glittery and purple. A true party in a bottle, this polish has a purple base with pink-to-magenta shimmer and holographic bar glitter.

polishes.name: New Horizon
polishes.description: 🌈 Introducing New Horizon 🌈 A periwinkle base with a strong red/orange/pink shifting shimmer and added holographic sparkle, New Horizon was created in support of The Trevor Project. For every bottle sold, $5 will be donated to The Trevor Project and their mission to provide crisis support and suicide prevention services for LGBTQ+ young people. Thank you for helping us make a difference, one mani at a time. 💜 www.thetrevorproject.org

polishes.name: Not as I Do
polishes.description: Not As I Do is a deep purple based polish packed with holo and fine micro glitters that flash red, blue and pink. Take a stand and let this sparkly beauty do the talking. Impulsive but strong, this polish captures the essence of good intentions.

polishes.name: Oceanlit Sky
polishes.description: Take a stroll beneath the Oceanlit Sky, where you’ll be entranced by nature's beauty. This captivating polish has a deep peacock teal base, color shifting flakes, and blue microglitters. It's like staring into the ocean waves at night and noticing how the stars reflect off the water.

polishes.name: Overdrive
polishes.description: Overdrive is a punchy neon red with orange shimmer. This polish demands attention and sets the stage wherever it goes.

polishes.name: Particle Storm
polishes.description: Particle Storm is a clear based polish packed with neon confetti. An explosion of playfulness and color to elevate your look.

polishes.name: Pressed Petals
polishes.description: Pressed Petals has a warm, buildable sheer base swimming with enchanting flakes. This striking polish is reminiscent of a colorful bouquet. Pressed Petals is a Small Batch polish. There is a limited number available and the recipe was not written down. Once sold out this polish will not be returning.

polishes.name: Prototype
polishes.description: **this polish will come in round bottles until further notice** This is a mystery polish and they will not be numbered. They may contain holo, shimmer, glitters, reflectives, and/or flakes.

polishes.name: Quiet Rebellion
polishes.description: Quiet Rebellion is an electric violet based polish with green shimmers. Like vibrant flowers peering through lush foliage, making a statement as petals unfurl.

polishes.name: Radiant Reactor
polishes.description: Radiant Reactor is a shocking neon green with pink shimmer and holo. This polish oozes with rebellious poise and an unapologetic aura.

polishes.name: Rosy Maple Glow Oops!
polishes.description: This is the Oops version! This batch turned out a little more yellow than I was wanting. Rosy Maple Glow Details:This shade is Limited Edition and can only be purchased from https://www.smidgenofus.com Rosy Maple Glow is an enchanting yellow packed with rose holo glitters and an intense pink glow. Much like the Rosy Maple Moth of eastern North America, this polish gives cute and playful vibes. It's hard not to feel cheerful wearing this beauty. Please note this shade is pre-order from 2/23/26-2/28/26. This shade can only be purchased on the Smidgen of Us Website.

polishes.name: Rosy Maple Glow Sou
polishes.description: This shade is Limited Edition and can only be purchased from https://www.smidgenofus.com Rosy Maple Glow is an enchanting yellow packed with rose holo glitters and an intense pink glow. Much like the Rosy Maple Moth of eastern North America, this polish gives cute and playful vibes. It's hard not to feel cheerful wearing this beauty. Please note this shade is pre-order from 2/23/26-2/28/26. This shade can only be purchased on the Smidgen of Us Website.

polishes.name: Royal Embers
polishes.description: Burst of Embers Sibling! Royal Embers makes its presence known with an intense gold to orange shimmer and scattered red sparkle nestled in a plum jelly base. Like the setting sun illuminated just beyond the horizon, this polish evokes a sense of peace and grandeur.

polishes.name: Sea Turtle Cove
polishes.description: Sea Turtle Cove is reminiscent of a day at the beach, basking in the sun as the salty air tickles your senses. This deep seafoam green polish is packed with holo and a yearning for tranquility.

polishes.name: Solar Static
polishes.description: Solar Static is a vivid neon orange with a refreshing green shimmer. Be one of a kind with this bold and energizing color.

polishes.name: Storm Watch
polishes.description: Storm Watch is a shimmering deep blue polish packed with fine glitter. This captivating shade is like a calm, starry night following a raging tempest. Storm Watch is a Small Batch polish. There are only 10 that were made and the recipe was not written down. Once sold out this polish will not be returning.

polishes.name: Stupid Canadian Wolf Bird
polishes.description: Don't be scared, it's just a Stupid Canadian Wolf Bird. This polish has a blackened base with silver magnetic pull, red micro glitters, black flakes and silver bar glitters. It's hauntingly beautiful, like the call of the loon.

polishes.name: Sugar Rush Crush
polishes.description: Sugar Rush Crush is a sweet, very light pink based polish with pink and gold shimmer and silver, gold, and violet reflective glitter. This polish glistens like thousands of delicate sugar crystals at your fingertips.

polishes.name: Sunkissed Paradise Sou
polishes.description: This shade is Limited Edition and can only be purchased from https://www.smidgenofus.com Sunkissed Paradise has a bold orange base filled with teal/blue/purple and purple/orange/yellow flakes. Inspired by the iconic Bird of Paradise flower, this polish encapsulates the beauty of this exotic bloom. Please note this shade is pre-order from 4/23/26-4/30/26. This shade can only be purchased on the Smidgen of Us Website.

polishes.name: This Is Not Enough
polishes.description: Dancing the night away, but This is Not Enough. This red-violet based polish is packed with black/red large particle flakes, blue reflective glitters, and a blue/purple/red shifting magnetic pull. It's bursting with desire, like seeing a lover swept away off the dance floor.

polishes.name: Touched by Venom
polishes.description: Touched by Venom is a dark turquoise based polish with gold holo glitters. Drench your nails in this intoxicating shade and succumb to its beauty.

polishes.name: Tragic & Charming
polishes.description: Tragic and Charming lures you in with its powerful performance and leaves a formidable impression upon those who witness it. Tragic & Charming is a Small Batch polish. There is a limited number available and the recipe was not written down. Once sold out this polish will not be returning.

polishes.name: Twilight Mirage
polishes.description: Twilight Mirage is an indigo based polish with red shimmer and silver reflective glitter. Wondrous and enchanting, this polish gives a sense of hope and following your dreams. Please note: this polish is pigmented and may stain.

polishes.name: Ultraviolet Surge
polishes.description: Ultraviolet Surge is a tantalizing neon purple with teal shimmer and holo. Sweet and sassy, this polish has a confident and flirtatious energy.

polishes.name: Velvet Luxe
polishes.description: Savor the juicy allure of Velvet Luxe, a rich blackberry-plum based polish with gold light reflective glitter. This vibrant shade is refreshing and energetic, a perfect accompaniment to your look.

polishes.name: Voltage Rush
polishes.description: Voltage Rush is an energizing neon yellow with a light blue shimmer. Positively electrifying, this bright yellow is the epitome of summer and fun. *glow effect with black light. Polish does not glow in the dark.

polishes.name: Warp Speed
polishes.description: Warp Speed is a bright neon blue with orange shimmer and holo. The perfect compliment to warmer days basking in the sun or racing home after a hard day's work.

polishes.name: Where Summer Ends
polishes.description: Where Summer Ends is a striking magenta creme with a delicate shimmer. This polish blends warmth and coolness, much like the transition between summer and fall.

polishes.name: Wishing Star
polishes.description: Wishing Star is magic in a bottle. This azure blue polish has iridescent flakes and an orange aurora shimmer. It's like wearing glistening sea glass on your fingertips (or toes!).

polishes.name: Xoxo
polishes.finish: Reflective, Holographic, Glitter, Shimmer, Top Coat
polishes.description: Indulge in XOXO, a milky white based polish with pink shimmer and gold reflective glitter. Like creamy, smooth melted marshmallow, this polish is truly decadent.
